research_question: does an oblique-view model discriminate the diseased breast from its contralateral counterpart within the same patient

augmentation.horizontal_flip_rationale: mirroring exchanges left and right breast; disease is unilateral
augmentation.photometric_jitter_rationale: images are standardised individually; absolute intensity is not meaningful

model_selection: none: fixed epoch budget, the final model is scored
threshold_rule: balanced accuracy maximized on validation breasts of each fold
within_patient_test: sign test on the ordering of the two breasts of one patient; immune to any patient-level covariate, including age
